[SWS_CM_10542] Local access control on providing service instances
⌈
If a Process requests to provide a service instance or any element thereof, but there
exists no ComOfferServiceGrant that
• does not reference any remote subject in the role remoteSubject and
• references the requested ProvidedApServiceInstance in the role servi-
ceInstance and the ProvidedApServiceInstance is referenced by a Ser-
viceInstanceToPortPrototypeMapping in the role serviceInstance
and the ServiceInstanceToPortPrototypeMapping references the re-
questing Process in the role process,
then Communication Management shall drop the request.
⌋

[SWS_CM_10542] Local access control on providing service instances
⌈
If a Process requests to provide a service instance or any element thereof, but there
exists no ComOfferServiceGrant that
• does not reference any remote subject in the role remoteSubject and
• references the requested ProvidedApServiceInstance in the role servi-
ceInstance and the ProvidedApServiceInstance is referenced by a Ser-
viceInstanceToPortPrototypeMapping in the role serviceInstance
and the ServiceInstanceToPortPrototypeMapping references the re-
questing Process in the role process,
then Communication Management shall drop the request.
⌋

[SWS_CM_10542] Local access control on providing service instances
⌈
If a Process requests to provide a service instance, but there exists no ComOf-
ferServiceGrant that
• does not reference any remote subject in the role remoteSubject and
• references the requested ProvidedApServiceInstance in the role servi-
ceInstance and the ProvidedApServiceInstance is referenced by a Ser-
viceInstanceToPortPrototypeMapping in the role serviceInstance
and the ServiceInstanceToPortPrototypeMapping references the re-
questing Process in the role process,
then CM shall drop the request. In that case the constructor of the ServiceSkeleton
class (see [SWS_CM_00153],[SWS_CM_00152] and [SWS_CM_00130]) shall handle
the error as a InsufficientPermissionsViolation.
⌋
